Note: Using lab-reared eggs and offspring collected from the 2024 field survey

Survey Time: Sw male ratio was counted as SwNw/Toal males

Lw.Nw and Sw.Nw indicate ancestral long-wing males with normal wing veins and small-wing males with reduced wing length and normal wing veins, respectively. Cw.Nw represents males with long wings but exhibiting 3D morphological variation (curly wings), while Cw.Sw denotes males with 3D variation who also carry reduced wing length. Rw.Nw males have a gap between stridulatory file teeth but maintain normal wing veins.
